latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.

aiDescription.summary: Creates a five‑year USDA pilot paying producers when national seasonal prices for certain produce fall below a five‑year reference because of imports. Applies to asparagus, bell peppers, blueberries, cucumbers, squash sold raw in a four‑week window; limits recipients to producers with average AGI <$5,000,000 and ≥75% farming income; authorizes $200M/year.

impact.summary: The Protecting Our Produce Act would require USDA to run a pilot paying U.S. asparagus, bell pepper, blueberry, cucumber, and squash producers when import-driven seasonal prices fall below a five-year reference price. Payments are authorized at $200,000,000 annually and target producers with under $5,000,000 AGI.
